record.title: Macroscopic description for networks of spiking neurons
record.venue: RECERCAT (Consorci de Serveis Universitaris de Catalunya)

system.title: Macroscopic description for networks of spiking neurons

topic_app.label: Collective dynamics of spiking networks
topic_app.detail: Neuroscience framing: brain function from collective spiking.

topic_ai.label: Mean-field reduction of neuronal networks
topic_ai.detail: Framed as reducing a microscopic population to firing-rate variables.

problem.label: No exact rate-to-microstate correspondence
problem.detail: Earlier mean-field theories were not exact.

application.label: Tool for network self-organization studies
application.detail: Intended to study how networks process information.

family.label: Exact mean-field (MPR) theory
family.detail: Exact reductions of spiking populations to macroscopic equations.

novelty.label: Rate and mean voltage coupled by spike generation
novelty.detail: Spike generation couples firing rate and mean membrane potential.

conclusion.label: Link to Ott-Antonsen theory
conclusion.detail: Firing-rate description maps conformally to Kuramoto order parameter.
